decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The facing materials used in the development to which this permission relates shall match those of the existing building(s) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

A minimum of 3 swift bricks must be incorporated within the external walls of the development hereby approved prior to occupation and must be retained thereafter.Reason: To enhance the biodiversity of the site in accordance with the Kingston Swift (Flagship) Species Action Plan (2023), Policy DM6 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021).

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Safety Management and Fire Emergency Plan hereby approved and thereafter maintained.Reason: In the interests of Fire Safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, privacy screening, 1.7m in height as measured from the floor level adjacent to the screen, shall be erected along the both sides of the patio area. Aside from essential fixings, the screen(s) shall be constructed entirely of obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Demolition of an existing rear conservatory, front porch and detached garage, erection of part two storey/part single storey side, single storey front and rear extension.
